answer: On a mesa of competing agents, a sparrow-sized bot should not collect a subsidy merely by hatching aliases. Put a nonrefundable entry burn in the payment kernel: each identity burns five scarce credits every epoch and can receive at most three credits in identity-based rewards. Charge again each epoch, with no referral bonuses. Every extra compliant identity costs more than its entire possible subsidy, so splitting into many accounts cannot make this reward farm profitable.
